equation_summary: Per token with matrix state S in R^{K x V}: S' = exp(g_t) * S_{t-1} with g_t a per-HEAD scalar log-decay; delta = beta_t * (v_t - k_t^T S'); S_t = S' + k_t delta^T; o_t = (scale*q_t)^T S_t. Decay precedes retrieval and read is after update (naive.py:54-59). g itself is computed externally as g = -exp(A_log)*softplus(g_in + dt_bias) (gate.py:20-50), so the value is data-dependent but the gate SCOPE is a plain per-head scalar — not a data-dependent-position gate in the sense of a typed axis.
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[QKV/beta/decay gate] ; U2.D(explicit decay) ; E[output/cache]: mixer op signature takes g:[B,T,H] scalar per head (naive.py:31,54) and applies decay-then-delta-then-read in canonical order.
CONFIRM decay ordering blocker: chunk naive (naive.py:127-153) uses cumsum log-decay with decay applied to state before retrieval — source-specific ordering must be preserved as stated.

CORRECT note: the 'ATMA decode equivalence' string does not correspond to anything findable in the pinned fla source (no ATMA/atma symbol in fla/); interpret it as the general requirement that the fused_recurrent decode path (fused_recurrent.py:121 applies scale to q, exp(g) decay per step) matches the chunk path — the blocker stands but the name is unverifiable from source.
direction_justification: The mixer is exactly U2.D with a per-head scalar gate (head-scope decay), which the canonical linear-delta contract already admits, so only B[K2_graph_execution] blocks it.
open_questions: What 'ATMA' refers to — no such identifier exists in the pinned fla tree; confirm whether it names an external decode kernel or is a stale label.
Whether beta sigmoid and A_log/dt_bias parameterization belong in the descriptor's numerical policy or stay fully external (current ledger treats them as E[], which source supports).
